title: Field not permitted in query: status

posts.name: Zaryab Qureshi
posts.cooked:
Hello,

Whenever I click on the HR Performance module, it throws the following error:

Field not permitted in query: status

Has anyone else faced this issue? Any guidance on how to resolve it would be appreciated.

Thanks in advance.

Frappe Framework: v15.76.0 (version-15)
ERPNext: v15.75.1 (version-15)

posts.name: Frappe User
posts.cooked: add the status field in the document
